recipe.visualDefinition: A classic 1960s album cover featuring a high-contrast studio portrait of a male vocalist positioned on the right, set against a deep black background. The left side is occupied by a staggered list of song titles in alternating blue and white, with a prominent horizontal header bar at the top containing the artist and album name.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject on the right balanced by text block on the left
Alternating color rhythm in the tracklist
Header bar providing a structural anchor at the top edge
High-key lighting on the face against a low-key background
coreInvariants: Two-tone color palette for text (Cerulean Blue and White)
Close-up portrait with a three-quarter view

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Portrait occupies the right half of the frame, scaled from chest up, angled slightly toward the center.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright, warm-toned face of the subject acts as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the top header bar, moves down through the staggered tracklist on the left, and rests on the subject's face on the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive black space behind the text and subject, creating a dramatic, moody atmosphere.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the subject's skin/white shirt and the black background; medium saturation in the blue accents.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family used in different weights and colors to create hierarchy.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the mid-century grotesque feel and narrow width.
Similar weight and condensed nature, though slightly more aggressive.
Provides the clean, Swiss-inspired legibility common in 60s design.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast studio portrait of a man with 1960s styled hair, wearing a patterned knit sweater over a white collared shirt. The subject should be on the right side of the frame against a solid black background. Leave the top 15% of the frame for a header and the left side for text.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a white horizontal bar at the top. Place bold condensed sans-serif text in blue inside the bar. Below the bar on the left, add a list of all-caps text in a staggered right-aligned format, alternating colors between white and cerulean blue.

verificationChecks: Does the text alternate colors correctly?
Is the header bar present at the top?

mustAchieve: Dramatic chiaroscuro lighting on the subject

postGenerationChecks: Ensure no text is cut off by the frame edges.
Verify the blue color matches a 1960s print aesthetic.
Check that the subject's gaze is directed slightly toward the text.
Confirm the sweater texture is visible and detailed.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a high-contrast studio portrait on a dark field with a structured, color-coded typographic list and a solid header bar for a mid-century editorial look.
